card.name: Start of action sentence after a warning
card.fires_on: The first word of an instruction sentence (Care, Use, If, Consider) right after a warning about adverse events in patients. Also the word 'enzymes' at the end of a warning clause about liver findings, just before 'should discontinue'.

modes.label: Opening word of advice
modes.description: Sentence-starting word such as If, Consider, Use or Care right after a sentence reporting a risk.
modes.example: Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, have been reported in patients treated with ZAYNICH.<< If>> an allergic reaction to ZAYNICH

modes.label: End of the trigger condition
modes.description: The word 'enzymes' closing a condition clause right before the instruction to stop the drug.
modes.example: Patients receiving ACE inhibitors who develop jaundice or marked elevations of hepatic<< enzymes>> should discontinue the ACE inhibitor and receive
